may.ANALYZE: StellaContextualAdvisorPanel — examines existing content, returns findings + suggestions with a full accept/edit/reject/undo lifecycle
may.CONSULT: StellaGroundedQueryPanel — answers a posed question via a caller-supplied, evidence-backed, citation-bound runQuery seam
may.REVIEW: StellaValidatorPanel — reviews an SROI calculation for risk (evidence gaps, proxy risk, attribution risk, claim risk)
may.DRAFT_SUGGEST: suggestion text proposed by the advisor panel, applied only via an explicit onApply callback the human triggers — never auto-written

may_not: invent evidence — grounding-adapter.ts and the 4-way EvidenceSupportLevel (grounded/partially_grounded/insufficient_evidence/contradictory_evidence) constrain every claim to cited sources
approve proxies — canApproveProxy is a human, role-gated, server-side action; Stella has no write path to proxy approval status
approve reviews — canApproveRunMethodology explicitly excludes the run's own author and requires a human review-set role; Stella is not a role and cannot be the approver
certify impact — 'esta revisión no certifica, audita, aprueba ni garantiza el impacto' rendered verbatim in the validator panel's success and footer copy
silently change calculations — the SROI engine is deterministic and human/system-controlled; Stella panels are read-only advisors with no calculation write path
replace human decision — every panel ends in a human accept/edit/reject/undo/approve action, never an autonomous state transition
